title: cbuild_snapshot
description: A build as it was sold, stored in the _cbuild_snapshot meta of the kit's order item and kept for as long as the order is.

schema_version.description: The document's version. Version 1 is the only one so far.

assembly.description: Whether the shop assembles the build.

picks.description: Each slot's part, by the slot's key, in step order.

label.description: The slot's label, as the shopper read it.

name.description: The part's name when it was sold.

part.description: The part's product or variation ID.

quantity.description: How many of the part one build takes.

specs.description: The part's specs when it was sold, spec key to value as the index held them. Empty for a part the shop could no longer read.

lead_time.description: The kit's lead time, as the shopper read it. Empty for a build the shop does not assemble.

returns_notice.description: The kit's returns notice, as the shopper read it. Empty for a build the shop does not assemble.
